---
title: "Session 1 Instructor Notes"
---

## Teaching Notes

Emphasise that data checks are actuarial work, not administrative setup. Participants should learn to distrust imported data until keys, types, ranges, and totals have been checked.

## Expected Checks

```{r}
#| eval: false
policies |> summarise(rows = n(), policies = n_distinct(policy_id))
claims |> summarise(rows = n(), claims = n_distinct(claim_id))

anti_join(claims, policies, by = "policy_id")
```
